title: DISA STIG for Canonical Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (MITRE SAF InSpec profile 2.7.2, run by Cinc Auditor)
readScopes: SSH (ssh://) or WinRM (winrm://) login to the scanned host, or a JSON report the customer produced. The profile only reads: it runs commands such as stat, grep, rpm -q and sysctl. Many rules read root-only files, so give a non-root account sudo for those reads (--stig-sudo); without it they fail to read and report skipped or failed, never passed.
